Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

Nex employees may be expected to collaborate with colleagues across different time zones. Depending on the role and location, occasional travel may also be required for company events, external meetings, and other business-related activities.

The Role

We are a passionate team of engineers, designers, and artists building active, camera-based games for Nex Playground. Our products span fitness, character-driven action, family party play, and experimental new formats, including:

  • Fitness & training: NexGym, Zumba Fitness Party, Family Fitness Challenge, and Training Ground.

As our Software Engineer Intern (Game Development), you will work with the US game development team on production games, content updates, and new prototypes. description:
Are you a curious, analytical student who wants to see how strategy decisions get made at a fast-growing payments company? As a Business Strategy Intern on NMI’s Revenue Acceleration team, you’ll own strategic projects for our leadership team, covering pricing, monetization and competitive strategy across the payments and fintech landscape.

This is a US remote internship for Summer 2027, running 11–13 weeks. You’ll use AI throughout your work, partner with stakeholders across the business, and end the summer by presenting your findings and recommendations to our executive team. Working hours are 8am–5pm, Monday through Friday in your local time zone. We prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones, but welcome applicants from anywhere in the US.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You’ve probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We’re the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We’re creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what’s possible so they can think about what’s next. But we’re not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

  • Be a Good Person, It’s Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
  • Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
  • Raise the Bar. Good enough isn’t enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

What will I be doing?

  • Analyze pricing and monetization approaches across the payments and fintech industry, and turn them into practical recommendations for NMI.
  • Research the competitive landscape, including competitors’ product strategy, packaging, go-to-market approach and AI capabilities.
  • Use AI throughout your work, including agentic AI, generative AI and other AI tools, to research, analyze data, build models and create deliverables faster and at a higher level.
  • Build business cases and financial models that help leadership evaluate strategic opportunities.
  • Create reusable assets, such as competitive trackers and comparison frameworks, that the team can maintain and update over time.
  • Turn your analysis into executive-ready briefs and presentations, and refine them with input from cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Present your findings and recommendations to NMI’s executive team at the end of the summer.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Business, Finance, Economics or a related field, and returning to school after the internship (not graduating in 2027).
  • Prior professional experience, such as a previous internship or part-time role.
  • Strong financial modeling and Excel skills, with the ability to build models that support business decisions.
  • Clear, structured written and verbal communication, and confidence presenting to senior audiences.
  • A genuine interest in payments, pricing and strategy. Payments experience isn’t required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in consulting, banking, corporate strategy or fintech.
  • Experience with business intelligence tools, especially Tableau.

Do you feel like you have a slightly out of the ordinary career path or history? We are open to all walks of life and very willing to hear your story. Please don’t feel like this should be a barrier to securing a great career at NMI! We appreciate success can come in all shapes and sizes. Fill in the ‘Additional Info’ box on our application to tell us more about your path.

As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:

  • A remote first culture!
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership and a dedicated mentor
  • Real projects that make an impact, ending in a final presentation to the executive team

Please note: This is a summer internship and does not convert into a full-time role at the end of the program. Interns are welcome to apply to open positions across NMI through the standard hiring process after finishing their degrees.

We believe that having a diverse group of employees strengthens both our work and our workplace. We’re focused on making NMI more diverse and welcoming with initiatives like having a dedicated Diversity, Equity & Inclusion action group,

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

As a Strategy & Operations Intern on Pinterest’s Global Content Organization (GCO), you’ll support business planning, performance analysis, and scoped operational projects. You’ll turn data into clear insights, track progress against team goals, and identify practical ways to improve how work gets done.

What you’ll do:

  • Analyze business and operational metrics to identify trends, summarize findings, and explain performance against defined goals.
  • Build or improve a recurring report or dashboard for a focused set of metrics; document metric definitions and refresh steps.
  • Support team planning and goal-setting by organizing inputs, maintaining a milestone tracker, and surfacing open questions and dependencies.
  • Coordinate a scoped team project by tracking milestones, documenting decisions, and preparing concise status updates.
  • Review a routine workflow and recommend a practical improvement, including the expected benefit and suggested next step.
  • Use Pinterest-approved AI and internal tools, where appropriate, to support research, analysis, and workflow improvement; validate outputs, use sound judgment, and follow responsible-use guidance.


What we are looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience analyzing data to identify trends, answer defined business questions, and communicate clear takeaways.
  • Experience using spreadsheets, reports, dashboards, or similar tools to organize, analyze, and present information.
  • Ability to bring structure to ambiguous questions, identify relevant inputs, and develop practical next steps with manager guidance.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when tracking milestones, documenting decisions, and maintaining project materials.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to share concise updates and collaborate effectively with relevant stakeholders.
  • Ability to use AI to improve the speed and quality of relevant research, analysis, or workflow outputs while validating accuracy and quality.
  • High integrity and ownership when using AI and internal tools, including protecting sensitive data, following responsible-use guidance, and remaining accountable for final deliverables.

In-Office Requirement:

  • We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
  • For this role, all interns will work in a hybrid model (commutable distance to one of our offices, with in-person collaboration approximately 1–3 times per week). Specific location(s) will be confirmed during the interview and offer process.

Relocation Statement:

  • This position may be eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.
  • Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

We offer 2 internship start dates:

  • May 17, 2027 - August 6, 2027
  • June 14, 2027 - September 3, 2027 

US based applicants only

The minimum and maximum salary for this position is $7,000 - $9,500 monthly.

We are a company that is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.

Why RoboForce

RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company’s robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real-world deployment and scalability.

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer Intern to join us in developing advanced AI capabilities for robotics. The internship starts from November 2026 for 3-6 months. As part of our team, you will help build the foundational AI ecosystem, spanning data collection, labeling, training, evaluation, and deployment.

You will collaborate closely with a team of world-class AI engineers and gain hands-on experience solving real-world challenges at the intersection of artificial intelligence and robotics.

  • Train and improve robot foundation models, including vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models, for precise, contact-rich manipulation in industrial settings.

  • Build data pipelines for robot learning, including data collection, curation, labeling, and dataset quality assurance.

  • Design and run evaluations in simulation and on real robots to measure and improve model performance.

  • Deploy models on robots and optimize them for real-time onboard inference.

  • Work closely with robotics, hardware, and product teams to bring models from research to production.

  • Currently pursuing an advanced degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field, with a graduation date in 2026 or 2027.

  • Requires 5 days/week in-office collaboration with the teams.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Exposure to robot learning using tactile and/or vision-based sensors.

  • Expertise in object pose estimation, bimanual manipulation, and synthetic data.

  • 3–6 months, full-time
Compensation: 
  • $5,000 - $6,500 monthly salary

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

At Samsara, interns can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, an intern may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, an intern could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments. 

Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged. 

You should apply if…

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.
  • You want to build for scale. You'll work on technology that powers physical operations at a scale most engineers never experience.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Our engineers are deeply invested in our customers and the daily problems they face. They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next. You’ll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with success and product teams, and use metrics to ensure your work translates into real outcomes.
  • You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.
  • You're drawn to hard problems and own them end to end. You dig into complexity, research it thoroughly, and find the simplest solution that works - then see it through, holding yourself to a high standard along the way.
  • You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.
  • You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.

The Robotics Lab at Samsung Research America is a new facility under the Robot eXperience (RX) division dedicated to advancing the field of robotics through cutting-edge research and development. The lab’s mission is to develop advanced technologies to power intelligent robotic systems capable of manipulation, navigation, and complex reasoning for a variety of high-impact application areas. To achieve this mission, the lab collaborates closely with external entities such as universities, startups, and government labs, as well as with several Samsung Product and Advanced Research labs.

Position Summary: 

Samsung Research America is looking for advanced students and early-career researchers who have solid technical skills and rich academic experience in areas of robotics and embodied intelligence. Our ideal candidate explores novel AI technologies towards generalizing robots to perform tasks in the real world. Samsung’s unique advantage in the consumer electronics market and growing focus on AI and robotics will provide you with exciting technical challenges and a rewarding career experience. By leveraging Samsung’s vast product ecosystem to deliver novel user experiences, your work will define Samsung’s future in robotics and significantly impact real-world users. Starting this year, Samsung Research America introduces a new Intern Scholar Category with a full-time flexible duration between 6 months to 12 months working on high-impact projects requiring advanced technical and independent problem-solving skills.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Research and develop robot AI methods and systems that help generalize robots to perform tasks in the real world
  • Generate patents and scientific research papers for top-tier publications
  • Work with the team to develop and optimize robotics foundation models, real2sim2real techniques, and self-improvement techniques for embodied intelligence
  • Work within cross-functional, cross-divisional teams and assist in the design, analysis, and performance evaluation from concept to completion

Required Skills:

  • Currently pursuing a PhD degree in EECS/Robotics
  • Deep understanding of 3D representations (meshes, point clouds, Gaussian splats), coordinate frames, forward and inverse kinematics, and dynamics.
  • Experience with foundational computer vision techniques, including object detection, segmentation, tracking, and 3D pose estimation.
  • Extensive experience managing robot models, scenes, and assets using simulation platforms such as MuJoCo and Isaac Sim.
  • Demonstrated research experience in robot foundation models or agentic robotics approaches.
  • Strong research experience with one of the following: contact-rich manipulation, reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and full-body motion control.
  • Familiarity with Python, PyTorch, C++, and ROS2.
  • Excellent verbal communication and writing skills to effectively represent the derived results and technical concepts developed in the course of the work

This position is open to candidates who are legally authorized to work in the United States.

Our total rewards programs are designed to motivate and engage exceptional talent. The hourly pay rate range for roles at this level is listed below, but may be higher or lower in other states due to geographic differentials in the labor market. Within the hourly pay rate range, individual rates depend on a number of factors—including the role’s function and location as well as the individual’s knowledge, skills, experience, education and training. This is part of our comprehensive compensation package with annual bonus eligibility and generous benefits to help you live life well.
Hourly Pay Rate Range
$48—$63 USD

Additional Information

Disclosure of Trade Secrets

Samsung has a strict policy on trade secrets. In applying to Samsung and progressing through the recruitment process, you must not disclose any trade secrets of a current or previous employer.

Essential Job Functions

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, and frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Samsung Research America is committed to complying with all Federal, State and local laws related to the employment of qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact the recruiter or email sratalent@samsung.com.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Samsung, we believe that innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We aim to create a global team where everyone belongs and has equal opportunities, inspiring our talent to be their true selves. Together, we are building a better tomorrow for our customers, partners, and communities.

Advancing the World’s Technology Together

Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day--including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you’ll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and powering the future. 

We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We’re dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities.

What You’ll Learn

  • Project Overview: Develop systems software for memory and storage pools that support reinforcement-learning post-training of large language models
  • Skills You’ll Learn:
    • Core Linux kernel memory management for virtual machines
    • How to modify the Linux kernel memory/storage management subsystem
    • Contributing to the largest open source project in the world
    • Understand how open-source SW impacts Samsung business
    • Collaborating across team, Samsung, and industry

What You’ll Do

The Samsung Global Ecosystem Team (GOST) is seeking an intern to develop systems software for memory and storage pools that support reinforcement-learning post-training of large language models. The work will examine how rollout generation, reward evaluation, policy updates, and checkpoint recovery use shared resources. You will build a focused prototype using fabric-attached memory and SSD pool, and measure its effect on training progress, memory pressure, and recovery time.

GOST consists of a geographically distributed group of engineers making high impact contributions both in software and leadership to open ecosystems such as the Linux kernel and QEMU. This work supports Samsung’s latest storage and memory technologies.

As an intern, you will contribute to the SW ecosystem R&D efforts targeting Samsung’s latest memory and storage technologies globally through distributed open-source projects. The goal of the internship is to deliver a working memory-to-storage data path, a live RL post-training demonstration, and a measured explanation of when pooling improves training efficiency or recoverability.

Location: Daily onsite presence at our San Jose headquarters in alignment with our Flexible Work policy

Reports to: Principal Engineer

  • Responsibilities

    • Profile the RL post-training loop to identify memory-capacity limits, data-transfer overhead, storage stalls, and GPU idle time.
    • Develop one runtime feature that coordinates bounded memory staging, asynchronous storage writes, prefetching, or capacity allocation across workers.
    • Integrate the feature with an existing RL framework using its training and checkpoint interfaces.
    • Preserve snapshot consistency, policy-version provenance, buffer ownership, and durable checkpoint publication during asynchronous operations.
    • Compare memory-only, storage-only, and combined pool configurations using training throughput, GPU-hours, local-memory usage, and restart performance.
    • Deliver correctness tests, reproducible experiments, design documentation, and code suitable for review and potential open-source contribution.
    • Find the resource management issue on post-RL workload and resolve the issue in host OS.
    • Complete other responsibilities as assigned.
    • Complete other responsibilities as assigned.

What You Bring

  • Pursuing Masters, or PhD in Computer Science
  • Must have at least 1 academic quarter/semester remaining
  • Programming experience in C, C++, or Rust, with Python or shell scripting for experiments and automation.
  • Understanding of operating systems, memory management, concurrency, and computer architecture.
  • Experience developing and debugging on Linux, using Git, and communicating technical results—coursework and research projects count.
  • CXL, NUMA, Device-DAX, mmap, shared-memory programming, or memory allocators, preferred
  • GPU programming, CUDA, DMA, or profiling memory and data-transfer performance, preferred
  • Distributed systems, cache management, vllm, sglang, LLM inference, or open-source development, preferred
  • You’re inclusive, adapting your style to the situation and diverse global norms of our people.
  • An avid learner, you approach challenges with curiosity and resilience, seeking data to help build understanding.

description:
The Role

We are seeking exceptional candidates to join our Quantitative Research and strat teams in Hong Kong where they will work with other researchers and developers on various research projects, including the design of novel predictive signals, enhancement of our algorithms for prediction, trade execution, portfolio construction, risk management, product and asset modelling. Interns will have an opportunity to meaningfully contribute to all facets of a successful quantitative trading business; help it grow and diversify.     

What You’ll Do

As a Quantitative Researcher/strat Intern you will be directly responsible for furthering our platform build and/or alpha research. You will understand the economics of a fundamental domain, and the corresponding insights that can be gathered from associated alternative data offerings.  You will identify compelling differentiating factors, design novel predictive signals, backtest & validate hypotheses.  You will have the opportunity to collaborate with senior team members to learn what it takes to be a successful quantitative strat + researcher. 

What You’ll Bring

  • Current BSc, MSc PhD student in quantitative or technical field such as statistics, economics, mathematics, physics, electrical engineering, or computer science (ideally with one or two years left in your academic program)
  • Excellent programming skills in languages such as Python, C, C++, Java, SQL, or R
  • Strong knowledge of probability and statistics (e.g., machine learning, time-series analysis and forecasting, pattern recognition, NLP, and unstructured data analysis).
  • The ability to communicate research ideas clearly and succinctly
  • Creative problem-solving skills and experience working with real-world datasets
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Please submit your CV/resume in English

We’d Love if You Had

  • Previous financial industry experience although it is not required
  • An advanced degree in a quantitative or technical field


Who We Are 

Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income.

Our Culture

At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls.

Acerca de Sezzle

Con la misión de empoderar financieramente a la próxima generación, Sezzle está revolucionando la experiencia de compra más allá de los pagos, combinando tecnología de vanguardia con planes de pago a cuotas sin intereses que hacen que comprar sea más inteligente y accesible. No solo estamos transformando los pagos; estamos redefiniendo la forma en que las personas descubren, interactúan y compran lo que aman, al tiempo que generamos un impacto real en las ventas de los comercios gracias a mayores conversiones y valores de compra más altos. Mientras seguimos dando forma al futuro de las fintech y el retail, estamos construyendo un equipo innovador, dinámico y apasionado por crear mucho más que una transacción: una experiencia de compra verdaderamente única. Si te emociona romper esquemas en tecnología y ofrecer una experiencia transformadora para consumidores y comercios, ¡únete a Sezzle y ayúdanos a crear el futuro de las compras!

Importante: este rol requiere inglés B2 o superior (escrito y oral). Trabajarás a diario con equipos en Estados Unidos, y gran parte de tu trabajo (herramientas, políticas, casos y reuniones) será en inglés. Si tu nivel de inglés es B1 o inferior, este rol no es para ti en este momento.

Acerca del rol

Como Practicante de Prevención de Fraude, harás parte de nuestro equipo de Shopper Risk Operations, el equipo que mantiene a Sezzle seguro para compradores y comercios. Revisarás actividad marcada por nuestros sistemas de detección de fraude y por Customer Support, decidirás qué es fraude y qué no, y nos ayudarás a detectar nuevos patrones de fraude antes de que se propaguen. Trabajarás junto a analistas, científicos de datos e ingenieros, y verás cómo funciona la prevención de fraude dentro de una fintech de rápido crecimiento que cotiza en bolsa.

Buscamos un/a practicante talentoso/a y motivado/a, que combine un alto coeficiente intelectual con una alta inteligencia emocional. No necesitas experiencia previa en fraude; te capacitaremos. La curiosidad, la atención al detalle y el buen criterio importan más.

Es una práctica remunerada, de tiempo completo y remota: de lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a. m. a 5:30 p. m. hora local.

Lo que harás

  • Revisar transacciones y cuentas marcadas por posible fraude o abuso
  • Investigar casos con nuestras herramientas y políticas internas, y decidir si bloquearlos o aprobarlos
  • Buscar patrones en los datos de cuentas y transacciones
  • Compartir tus hallazgos para mejorar nuestras reglas y modelos de detección de fraude
  • Gestionar tu cola de casos a tiempo y dejar notas claras
  • Ayudar a resolver escalamientos de equipos internos

Lo que aprenderás

  • Cómo las fintech detectan y previenen el fraude, desde la revisión manual hasta los modelos de machine learning
  • Cómo investigar casos y tomar decisiones con datos
  • Cómo trabajan juntos los equipos de riesgo, operaciones, datos e ingeniería

Lo que buscamos

  • Inglés B2 o superior (escrito y oral): es indispensable para este rol
  • Estudiante universitario/a o recién graduado/a. Ingeniería Industrial o de Sistemas, Economía, Administración, Finanzas, Contaduría, Estadística, Derecho y carreras afines encajan muy bien
  • Excelente atención al detalle y buen criterio
  • Comodidad trabajando con números y hojas de cálculo (Excel o Google Sheets)
  • Comunicación escrita clara
  • Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma después de la capacitación
  • Comodidad usando herramientas de IA como Claude o ChatGPT para potenciar la productividad, la investigación y la comunicación

Deseable

  • Cursos o proyectos de análisis de datos (Excel, SQL o similares)
  • Interés en fintech, pagos o ciberseguridad

Sobre ti

  • Tienes estándares implacablemente altos: muchas personas pueden pensar que tus estándares son excesivamente altos. Constantemente subes la vara e impulsas a quienes te rodean a lograr grandes resultados. Te aseguras de que los errores no avancen en la cadena y de que los problemas se solucionen de forma definitiva.
  • No te limitan las convenciones: tu éxito, y gran parte de la diversión, está en desarrollar nuevas formas de hacer las cosas.
  • Necesitas acción: la velocidad importa en los negocios. Muchas decisiones y acciones son reversibles y no requieren un análisis exhaustivo. Valoramos la toma de riesgos calculados.
  • Te ganas la confianza: escuchas con atención, hablas con franqueza y tratas a los demás con respeto.
  • Tienes carácter; disientes y luego te comprometes: puedes cuestionar respetuosamente las decisiones cuando no estás de acuerdo, incluso cuando hacerlo es incómodo o agotador. Tienes convicción y eres tenaz. No cedes solo por mantener la armonía del grupo. Una vez se toma una decisión, te comprometes por completo.
  • Entregas resultados: te enfocas en los factores clave y los entregas con la calidad adecuada y a tiempo. A pesar de los obstáculos, estás a la altura de las circunstancias y nunca te conformas.

Lo que hace increíble trabajar en Sezzle

En Sezzle somos mucho más que ingenieros brillantes, apasionados por los datos, pensadores creativos e innovadores decididos. Creemos en rodearnos solo de los mejores y más brillantes. Nuestra cultura no se define por una serie de beneficios diseñados para dar la ilusión de la típica cultura startup, sino por el ejemplo visible que vive en cada persona que contratamos.

Compensación: el salario para el rol de Practicante de Prevención de Fraude es de $800 USD brutos mensuales.

description:
About Sezzle

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role

As a Fraud Operations Intern, you'll join our Shopper Risk Operations team, the people who keep Sezzle safe for shoppers and merchants. You'll review activity flagged by our fraud detection systems and Customer Support, decide what's fraud and what isn't, and help us spot new fraud patterns before they spread. You'll work alongside analysts, data scientists, and engineers, and see how fraud prevention works inside a fast-growing, publicly traded fintech.

We are seeking a talented and motivated intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. No prior fraud experience is required; we'll train you. Curiosity, attention to detail, and good judgment matter more.

This is a paid, full-time, remote internship: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:30 pm local time.

What You'll Do

  • Review transactions and accounts flagged for possible fraud or abuse
  • Investigate cases using our internal tools and policies, and decide whether to block or clear them
  • Look for patterns in account and transaction data
  • Share what you find to help improve our fraud rules and detection models
  • Work through your case queue on time and keep clear notes
  • Help resolve escalations from internal teams

What You'll Learn

  • How fintech companies detect and prevent fraud, from manual review to machine learning models
  • How to investigate cases and make decisions with data
  • How risk, operations, data, and engineering teams work together

What We Look For

  • Current university student or recent graduate. Industrial or Systems Engineering, Economics, Business, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Law, and related fields are a great fit
  • Strong attention to detail and good judgment
  • Comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets)
  • English at B2 level or higher (written and spoken)
  • Clear written communication
  • Able to work independently once trained
  • Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to boost productivity, research, and communication

Nice to Have

  • Coursework or projects involving data analysis (Excel, SQL, or similar)
  • Interest in fintech, payments, or cybersecurity

About You

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What you’ll do

About the internship

Stripe's Applied ML, Data Science, Risk, and Payments organizations are excited to offer PhD machine learning engineering internships for the summer of 2027. This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to critical projects that directly enhance Stripe's suite of products, focusing on areas such as foundation models used for dozens of tasks e.g. fraud detection, enhanced support, and predicting user behavior.

As an intern, you'll tackle challenging problems at the intersection of finance, technology, and data. You'll have the chance to work on creative projects like the Stripe Assistant and the Stripe Foundation Model, which leverage machine learning to revolutionize how businesses interact with financial services and data.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and deploy large-scale machine learning systems that drive significant business value across various domains.
  • Engage in the end-to-end process of designing, training, improving, and launching machine learning models.
  • Write production-scale ML models that will be deployed to help Stripe enable economic infrastructure access for a diverse range of businesses globally.
  • Collaborate across teams to incorporate feedback and proactively seek solutions to challenges.
  • Rapidly learn new technologies and approaches, demonstrating a strong ability to ask insightful questions and communicate the status of your work effectively.

Who you are

Minimum requirements

  • A deep understanding of computer science, obtained through the pursuit of a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related field, with the expectation of graduating in winter 2027 or spring/summer 2028.

description:
About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

About the Team

Our internship program is structured to provide interns with the opportunity to work on real projects that our customers urgently need. In this role you will be part of the Product Design team, which is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about.

What You'll Do

As a Product Design Intern, you will focus on designing and building experiences that will be shipped to our users in production. You will contribute design iterations to ongoing project workstreams, tackling important projects to increase global commerce, and help shape brand new experiences. Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. 

Key responsibilities include:

  • Work on a product design project with a product team, translating business ideas into real experience.
  • Help craft thoughtful experiences that enable startups and large businesses to establish and manage their businesses.
  • Apply problem-solving skills and human-centered approaches to address complex and ambiguous business and user problems.
  • Develop and refine design solutions by partnering closely with other designers.
  • Craft and prototype visually polished experiences to get user feedback. 
  • Partner closely with engineering to implement a feature/product from design to implementation, and get it in the hands of our users.
  • Engage in group design critiques and collaborative design sessions to improve and receive feedback on your work.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, data scientists, and researchers, proactively seeking and incorporating feedback.
  • Understand and advocate for our users, participating in the design process from early concepts to final delivery.

Who You Are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Mas

Stripe’s Controllership organization is responsible for the accurate and timely recording of Stripe’s business activities, the integrity of our financial reporting, and the scalable processes and controls that support our growth. We partner across Finance, Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit to understand Stripe’s products and operations, resolve complex financial issues, and maintain a strong control environment.

We are hiring four Controllership Interns, with one role on each of the following teams: Accounts Receivable (AR), Controls, Product Accounting, and Corporate Accounting. In any placement, you’ll work with experienced teammates and cross-functional partners on meaningful accounting, data, systems, controls, or process-improvement work.

  • Accounts Receivable (AR) supports invoicing, collections, cash application, and related financial operations through scalable, accurate, and auditable processes.
  • Controls supports Stripe’s internal-control environment by documenting and assessing processes, identifying risks, supporting control testing, and helping teams design sustainable improvements.
  • Product Accounting supports Stripe’s products by understanding their financial-data flows, evaluating accounting implications, and developing scalable processes
  • Corporate Accounting supports Stripe’s close, financial reporting, corporate accounting processes, and control environment

  • Prepare or support journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting schedules, variance analysis, and other accounting deliverables

description:
5G SA O-RAN Test Bed Co-Op (Engineering Co-Op)

This is a full-time, in-person role at our Woburn, MA office. We are ideally seeking someone who can start in January 2027.

Are you interested in exploring the future of wireless communications and gaining hands-on experience with next generation 5G technologies? At STR, interns work alongside experienced engineers and software developers on meaningful projects that address challenging technical problems related to national security.

Our internship program gives you the opportunity to gain practical engineering experience, learn from experienced mentors, and develop skills in open-source software, Linux-based networking, and wireless communications. You’ll work in a collaborative engineering environment while contributing to the development and integration of emerging 5G technologies.

As part of the intelligence team, you’ll help establish and maintain a 5G Standalone (SA) Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) test bed using open-source software, including the Linux Foundation’s O-CU/DU and complementary components. You’ll gain hands-on experience configuring network and RAN components, integrating core-network systems, automating test-bed deployments, and troubleshooting interoperability challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Assist the team in establishing and maintaining a 5G Standalone (SA) O-RAN test bed using open-source software.
  • Install, configure, and maintain Linux-based networking and Radio Access Network (RAN) components.
  • Collaborate with the software development team to integrate core-network and O-RAN components.
  • Develop scripts and automation tools to support repeatable test-bed setup and configuration.
  • Troubleshoot networking, integration, and interoperability issues across system components.
  • Document system configurations, test procedures, troubleshooting processes, and experimental results.
  • Participate in hands-on lab experimentation and learn about emerging 5G technologies and open-source wireless systems.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, telecommunications, or a related technical discipline.
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts and protocols.
  • Comfortable working in a Linux-based development environment.
  • Some experience with Python or shell scripting.
  • Interest in 5G wireless communications, Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN), and open-source software.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with software developers and engineering teams.
  • U.S. citizenship is required due to the nature of STR’s work and clearance requirements.

Perks:

  • Competitive pay
  • Flexible working hours
  • Fun activities both in and outside the office

Pay Information
Hourly Range: $25.20-$54.00/hour

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.


STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info.

Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

To help us do this essential work, The New York Times is hiring a Communications Intern. The person in this role will join our Communications team and be responsible for assisting the team with all aspects of the communications ecosystem, from researching media pitches, compiling data-driven media coverage reports to creating content for a variety of digital and multimedia platforms and vehicles, telling stories that embody the spirit, strength of character and mission of The Times. The intern will be a trusted steward of our mission and culture across the organization, helping to improve the employee experience for our 6,000 employees, while reinforcing the values that have sustained us over the past 170 years. 

We are looking for a talented and creative individual with a strong interest in communications who is resourceful and can work at a fast pace to support external communications efforts across all facets of our organization.

  • The rate of pay for this role is $20.00 per hour.

  • Maintain media lists, track media coverage, help compile press coverage reports.

The Organization 

At USAFacts, we believe facts deserve to be heard. We turn data from thousands of jurisdictions into clear, unbiased answers about how government spends money and what it achieves. No political agenda. No commercial motive. Just public service.

Founded and funded by Steve Ballmer, former CEO of Microsoft, we work alongside Ballmer Group Philanthropy and Rainier Climate on civic impact.

As an intern, you’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team and learn how complex public data becomes something the American people can actually use.

To top it off, Fast Company has recognized USAFacts four years running, including the 2026 Most Innovative Companies list. Learn more at usafacts.org and LinkedIn. Learn more about us at usafacts.org and linkedin.com/company/usafacts.

Your Internship with USAFacts

Pay

$33 per hour for at least 10 weeks, which comes to roughly $13,200 before taxes at 40 hours per week. Interns are overtime eligible, so hours over 40 per week are paid at time and a half.

Housing support

Relocating interns receive company-paid furnished corporate housing and a $1,000 travel reimbursement. Interns who live in the area and don’t need corporate housing can be reimbursed up to $2,000 per month for housing costs with a current rental agreement.

Paid sick days and holidays

3 paid sick days and paid holidays for the duration of your internship.

Hybrid schedule

In the office Tuesday through Thursday, with lunches provided, and the flexibility to work remotely or in-office the rest of the week.

Transportation

You’ll receive either an ORCA card for local public transit or paid parking in or near the building.

Events, community, and opportunities

At USAFacts, we believe a great internship is about more than just the work. Throughout the summer, you'll have opportunities to connect with your fellow interns, build relationships across the organization, and make the most of your time in the Seattle area. From organization-wide events and team outings to boat rides, paddleboarding adventures, and sushi dinners, you'll have plenty of opportunities to build connections and have fun along the way. Each intern cohort receives a dedicated morale budget to plan activities together and make the summer their own. You'll also have the unique opportunity to present your projects and accomplishments directly to USAFacts founder and former Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer and other organizational leaders.

 

The Opportunity

At USAFacts, we’re on a mission to provide a comprehensive, unbiased look at our country by the numbers, and we’re leveraging the latest and greatest in AI to do it. Over the past two years, our team has built a data platform for government data, a system of AI agents for accessing it, and the generative capabilities for our teams to create accurate, engaging, data-driven content like never before.

We’re looking for an aspiring product manager who is passionate about AI, consumer experiences, and data-driven storytelling to join us in building the future of data citizenship. You’ll focus on generative user experiences, prompting strategy, evaluation systems, and product analytics, helping us determine how to best leverage AI to equip Americans with the facts.

Key Priorities and Responsibilities

  • User & Market Research: Participate in user research initiatives, including surveys, feedback sessions, and usability testing to gather insights and feedback on new and existing features. Research and understand current trends in consumer-facing AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, CoPilot) and the civic tech landscape.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with design, engineering, and other teams to ensure smooth development and launch of features.
  • Product Requirements: Aid in documenting product requirements by collaborating with stakeholders, ensuring clarity and alignment with desired outcomes.
  • Assist with Product Roadmap: Support in maintaining and updating the product roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the team's goals and objectives.
  • QA Testing: Assist in the Quality Assurance process, helping identify bugs and ensuring features work as intended before release.
  • Metrics and Analysis: Support in tracking product metrics and analyzing user behavior to understand feature performance and areas of improvement.

description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.  

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.  

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL. 

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role 

Summer internships will range between the months of May and August. All dates dependent upon the university schedule of the selected students. Internships are full-time and on-site in El Segundo, CA. To be considered for this internship, candidates must be actively enrolled in an accredited undergraduate or graduate degree program. 

Site Reliability supports the infrastructure, hardware, software and services throughout all departments at Varda. We are responsible for ensuring services are running reliability and implementing new tools at scale. Day-to-day includes supporting team member onboarding, building out new engineering areas, troubleshooting difficult system administration challenges and implementing automation to scale our systems and services to support Varda's mission.

Internships at Varda are optimal for students looking to grow technically and professionally while working on impactful projects critical to the company’s success. You will be working on a collaborative team in a startup environment while being able to learn from some of most accomplished and experienced aerospace professionals in the world. We’re dedicated to providing an experience that will let your decisions and contributions help drive Varda’s success. 

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and manage services in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters using Argo CD

  • Assist with system patching and maintenance tasks for internal services

  • Upgrade and support Atlassian tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code efforts using Linux-based tooling and scripting

  • Monitor service reliability and automate operations tasks to improve system uptime and performance

Basic Qualifications

  • Python programming experience

  • Familiarity with Linux environments

  • Understanding of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)

  • Coursework or experience with one or more of the following:

    • Docker

    • Kubernetes

    • Networking or system security fundamentals

Preferred Skills And Experience 

  • Hands-on experience with cloud deployment (Azure, AWS, or GCP)

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in a lab or personal project setting

  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts or tools like Argo CD, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions

  • Previous internship, research, or project experience in DevOp

The Team/Project TRI's Robotics Division develops technologies that enable robots to operate effectively in complex, real-world environments. The project explores how foundation-model agents can understand manipulation tasks, reason about physical environments, and orchestrate reusable robotic capabilities to accomplish diverse objectives. Our research combines vision-language models, robotic perception, motion planning, manipulation, and robot learning. We investigate these questions through hands-on experimentation on physical robotic platforms. The Challenge Recent advances in foundation models have significantly improved AI systems' ability to understand visual scenes, reason about tasks, and plan sequences of actions. However, translating these capabilities into reliable physical robot behavior remains challenging. Robots must reason about three-dimensional geometry, physical constraints, contact interactions, and failures during execution. An important research question is how far foundation-model agents can go by leveraging existing robotic capabilities, and when specialized learned policies become necessary. The Opportunity We are seeking a Robotics Research Intern to investigate agentic approaches to robotic manipulation. You will work closely with researchers and engineers to develop systems that connect foundation-model reasoning with physical robot capabilities. Depending on your background and research interests, your project may focus on spatial reasoning, robotic skill orchestration, execution monitoring, failure recovery, or systematic evaluation of agentic manipulation systems. This internship offers an opportunity to tackle open research questions while gaining practical experience with cutting-edge AI models and real robotic systems. Your work will contribute to understanding how foundation-model agents can enable more generalizable and reliable robot autonomy.

description: At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences. This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role. Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns! The Mission We are building general-purpose robots that can perform a wide variety of dexterous, multi-step tasks in everyday environments. Our Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) are foundation models that generate robot actions from sensor data and natural-language requests. They are trained on a large curriculum of robot demonstrations, combined with internet-scale text, image, and video data and procedurally generated simulation data. A growing focus of the team is world action models: models that learn to predict both how the world will change and which actions the robot should take. Because they capture the consequences of actions, these models can support planning over long horizons, recovery from errors, and anticipation of what nearby people are likely to do. The Challenge We envision robots that help with household chores and cooking, support older adults in living independently, and work side by side with people. These settings are messy and unstructured, and useful tasks often take minutes rather than seconds. A robot must chain many skills together, notice and recover from mistakes, and adapt to the people around it. Our central question is what it will take for humanoids or other mobile manipulators to complete such long-horizon tasks reliably, safely, and naturally alongside people. We believe world action models, grounded in large-scale physical interaction data, are a key part of the answer for robot policy learning. The Internship We are seeking a research intern to adapt pre-trained world foundation models—through mid-training, fine-tuning, or post-training techniques—into world action models that serve as robot policies. These policies will be deployed on humanoid platforms or other mobile manipulators functioning within human-centered environments. Project focus areas can be customized based on your research interests, spanning model architecture design and training, long-horizon task execution, dynamic human-robot interaction, or real-world physical robot evaluation. You will work closely with researchers and engineers on the team to turn ideas into working prototypes, run experiments in simulation and on real robots, and publish results at peer-reviewed venues. You should be comfortable working with large existing datasets as well as a growing corpus of robot and human-interaction data. Areas of Focus World action models for long-horizon tasks. Human-robot interaction and collaboration. Humanoid whole-body manipulation. Cross-embodiment transfer and learning from human video. Sim-to-real and synthetic data. Post-training and continual learning.
